upstreamRuntime.contract: The only kernel import in this plugin's own modules. Called lazily for attribution headers; any failure degrades to a static fallback User-Agent. No kernel version is pinned. The vendored channel pack below is the one deliberate exception, and it is not this plugin's code.
upstreamRuntime.verifiedBy: scripts/catalog-test.mjs (adapter isolation gate, which exempts vendor/)

vendoredChannelPack.contract: A third-party dsh plugin carried verbatim and bundled into one file by scripts/build-channel-pack.mjs. It registers the fifteen account-channel providers (CodeArts, CodeBuddy/WorkBuddy, Qoder, Qoder CN, TRAE, Cline, Loomy, Raccoon, MiniMax, ZCode, Antigravity, Command Code, OfficeAce, AutoClaw; the upstream OpenCode account lane is mounted with its account access disabled, keeping only the anonymous free lane; AutoClaw Intl, LobsterAI, MonkeyCode, KukuAI, Accio, Accio CN and OrcaTerm were removed by product decision) and therefore imports the kernel itself; that import is upstream's design, not this plugin's seam. Mounted on its own fiber: a composition without credentials/commands/llm loses the channels and keeps the free lane. Credentials it obtains go to the host credential store, never to this plugin's files or to the browser. The authoritative provider list is the registration block in vendor/channel-pack/src/index.ts.
vendoredChannelPack.provenanceNotes: vendor/channel-pack/NOTICE.md records what was taken, what was left out (upstream's own browser half) and how to rebuild the bundle.
